title: dysphania oblanceolata
intro: Dysphania oblanceolata, commonly known as Chenopodium oblongifolium or bladder dock, is a plant species in the family Amaranthaceae. The plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, inflammation, and respiratory problems. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, diuretic, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for addressing various health concerns. The bioactive constituents of Dysphania oblanceolata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
